text.p: Atrix International Inc said Tuesday it entered a one-year distribution agreement with Ames Supply Co of Downers Grove, Ill.
Under the agreement, Ames Supply is granted non-exclusive rights to distribute the new Atrix Omega series vacuum and filter products.

"This is the second U.S. distributor that has contracted to sell the new Omega Series vacuum and filter line within the last 30 days," Steven Riedel, Atrix president, said in a statement. "Due to strong demand, we expect to reach agreement with several other major distributors in January."
He added the Omega Series is now being shipped into England and the Netherlands.
Atrix makes remote metering and copy control products, as well as toner vacuums, vacuum filters and printed circuit board transport cases for the office machine industry.
